results.trackName: Prayer Book 11 - Prayers for Multitudes in the Valley of Decision
results.description:
"Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision." (Joel 3:14)

Every day, multitudes stand between heaven and hell. Many are blinded and held captive by forces they cannot see. In this book, Dag Heward-Mills has outlined forty-two powerful prayer topics for the salvation of souls, each one standing on the Word of God. Pray to bind the strong man and cast down the accuser of the brethren. Pray for prison doors to open and for the lost to come to Christ. Pray until multitudes come out of the valley of decision into the kingdom of God!
